info.title: CIV.IQ Public API
info.description: Open REST API for normalized U.S. government data — federal and state legislators, bills, votes, campaign finance, lobbying, and ML-powered intelligence analysis. No API key required. Rate limited to 60 requests/minute per IP.

get.description: Lists all available v1 endpoints with descriptions.
Returns request counts per endpoint for a given date range. Authenticated with a bearer token (CACHE_WARM_SECRET). Intended for operational observability — not part of the citizen-facing read path.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Range start (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 7 days before today.

200.description: Request counts for the date range

get.description: List all current members of Congress with optional filtering.
Get detailed info for a specific member of Congress.
List latest bills from Congress.
Get bill detail from Congress.gov.
Get cached AI-generated plain-language summary. Does not trigger live generation.
Get roll-call vote details including individual member positions.
Get district info and its representatives.
List congressional committees.
Get committee detail with members and subcommittees.
Version history with change descriptions.

post.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint for AI assistant integration. 16 tools, 3 resources, 3 prompts. See https://modelcontextprotocol.io

get.description: ML-based vote prediction using XGBoost model with SHAP explanations. Shows independence score, notable deviations from predicted behavior, and key factors driving predictions.
Traces lobbying money through contributions, committee assignments, and votes. Shows the path from lobbying organizations to legislative outcomes.
Quarterly voting pattern shifts over time. Shows how a legislator's alignment has changed across quarters.
Analyzes overlap between a legislator's campaign finance sources and their committee jurisdictions.
Top recipients of campaign contributions from a specific industry sector.

parameters.name: sector
parameters.description: Industry sector name (e.g., Defense, Health, Energy)

get.description: Campaign finance report card for representatives serving a ZIP code. ZIP-based responses include `accuracyNote` and `status: 'partial'` — ZIP ↔ congressional district alignment is 10–20% wrong. For authoritative results, use the address POST endpoint.

200.description: Money report for ZIP (approximate — see accuracyNote)

post.description: Campaign finance report card for representatives serving a street address.
Look up all federal representatives (House + Senate) for a street address. Address-based responses do NOT include `accuracyNote` — the district is authoritative.

accuracyNote.description: Populated only on ZIP-based GET responses (not address POST). Communicates that ZIP ↔ district alignment is 10–20% wrong and address-based lookup is preferred for authoritative results.

status.description: 'partial' when accuracyNote is set (ZIP input); 'complete' for address input.

get.description: ZIP-code fallback for the address-based lookup. Responses include `accuracyNote` and `status: 'partial'` because ZIP ↔ district alignment is 10–20% wrong; prefer the address POST endpoint for authoritative results.

accuracyNote.description: Present on ZIP-based responses. ZIP ↔ district alignment is 10–20% wrong; use address POST for authoritative results.

get.description: Legislators grouped by shared funding patterns. Reveals cross-party clusters with similar donor profiles.

parameters.name: bioguideId
parameters.description: Optional: get cluster for a specific legislator

get.description: Cross-domain search across representatives, bills, committees, and state legislators. Supports state prefix (e.g., CA:pelosi).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query. Supports state prefix (e.g., CA:pelosi)

get.description: Cross-domain search by policy area: bills, regulations, spending, and committees.

post.description: Resolve a street address to congressional district and representatives.

get.description: List all 435 congressional districts with demographics, political data, and representatives.
List all 535 current members of Congress.
Comprehensive profile with biography, committees, social media, contact info, and leadership roles.
Side-by-side comparison of voting record, campaign finance, and effectiveness for two or more legislators.
List state legislators for a given state via OpenStates.

parameters.name: chamber
parameters.description: Filter by chamber (upper = Senate, lower = House/Assembly)

get.description: Search and list state legislation via OpenStates.

post.description: Look up state legislators for a street address via OpenStates geocoding.

get.description: Get connected entities in the civic knowledge graph. Supports filtering by edge type, confidence, and temporal range.

parameters.name: nodeId
parameters.description: Node ID in format type:identifier (e.g., rep:P000197, bill:119-hr-1)

get.description: Unified entity resolver. Returns identity, neighborhood, intelligence, and temporal context for any civic entity.

parameters.name: nodeId
parameters.description: Entity ID in format type:identifier (e.g., rep:P000197)

get.description: Quarterly time-series of edge activity and trends for an entity.
Returns self-contained HTML for iframe embedding. Supports scorecard and district widget types.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Entity ID (bioguideId for scorecard, districtId for district)

get.description: Atom feed of a legislator's voting activity, committee assignments, and sponsored bills.
Atom feed of legislative activity affecting a congressional district.
Atom feed of recently introduced or updated bills in Congress.
Atom feed of status updates and actions for a specific bill.
Atom feed of committee meetings, reports, and member updates.

IntelligenceMetadata.description: Common metadata for all intelligence insights

accuracyNote.description: Present on ZIP-based GET responses. ZIP ↔ district alignment is 10–20% wrong; use the address POST endpoint for authoritative results.

status.description: 'partial' when accuracyNote is set (ZIP input); 'complete' for address input.

accuracyNote.description: Present when the request carried a ZIP code (body.zipCode) rather than pure coordinates or address-only. Downstream consumers using the returned district inherit ZIP imprecision (10–20% misalignment).

endpoints.description: Map of endpoint path → request count

BearerAuth.description: Operator bearer token (CACHE_WARM_SECRET). Required for internal observability endpoints under /v1.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded (60 requests/minute per IP)
